wordpressContentExposureIncident.summary: Two public WordPress MP3s are byte-identical to SHA-256 entries in the private WooCommerce protected download manifest. Protected directory denies anonymous access, but public copies answer HEAD 200 and one-byte Range GET 206.
wordpressContentExposureIncident.policy: Do not reveal direct source media URLs or exact filenames in public reports, and do not change production without owner approval.
